token pairs: every text pair 4.5:1, every UI pair 3:1 (computed in the page from tokens.css)
type floor and brand: DM Sans, paper background, 12 px smallest kit size, teal primary
status vocabulary: every stage and dispute status resolves; chips carry text and an icon (never colour alone)
maturity chips: Working is hidden until the presenter overlay is on; Simulated, Pilot and Future always show
modal: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, focus trap both ways, Escape, scrim click, focus return
drawer: same contract as the modal
popover: Escape closes it and focus returns to the control
confirm resolves true on Confirm and false on Cancel; the toast has role=status (alert for errors)
the old modal(html, onMount) helper is now an accessible dialog (screens keep working)
filter chips: aria-pressed, state in the URL query, survives a reload, Clear
search keeps focus while typing and filters rows
queue table: aria-sort, sort toggles, real links, ArrowDown moves between rows, Enter opens
queue table: sticky header, empty, loading and error states
evidence chip opens a popover with the quote and closes on Escape
timeline: an event opens a drawer with What, When, Who, Document, Source, Next action
draft review: edit text survives repaints; no bulk accept; Restore previous appears after a save
a store change (SSE) while someone is typing does not wipe the field; the repaint waits for blur
skip link is the first tab stop and moves focus to the main landmark
landmarks: <html lang>, a labelled nav, exactly one main, real links in the rail
focus moves to main on a route change and the route is announced
the old demo bar is gone from the product viewport
rail: light sand, 232 px wide, collapses to icons at 1024; counts only where meaningful
rail by role follows the permission table (supervisor, clinician, admin, direct support)
dock: hidden by default in Presentation, Ctrl+Shift+P toggles, label PRESENTER, mode always visible, above the viewport
dock: ?present=1 opens it; ?mode=explore docks it open (no hide control) and is stored in psyflo_mode
dock: role switcher changes the signed-in role without a page reload
dock: scenario selector calls demo.scenario, signs in as the scenario role and opens its route
dock: simulation controls (receive a reply, advance a day) live in the dock
dock: notes drawer "How the data gets in" with maturity chips, focus returns to Notes
dock: All screens picker is role-aware and searchable
UiKit is presenter-only: without the dock it says so; with ?present=1 it shows the gallery
prefers-reduced-motion: overlay animation is switched off
no console errors on the gallery, the stubs and the shell routes
